spec: Appendix B (final achievements list ~12–15, solo + crew, from approved mechanics) · Part IV rules table · Flow 6 · Flow 7 · 5.6.1 Award.achievement(id) · T006
rules: An achievement is earned once, the first time its trigger counter reaches threshold, and is never removed (V35). Triggers are counters the engine derives from facts: postsTotal · workoutsCompleted · currentStreak · perfectWeeks · prCount · shieldsConsumed · comebacks · crewJoined · reactionsGiven · crewFullPulseDays · crewFullPulseWeeks. Copy is gym-buddy voice (Part III Voice; 6.6 — sentence case, no '!'). Achievement unlocks fold into the completion celebration (E8) as Award.achievement(id).
